lead.headline: Anthropic's IPO filing draws scrutiny over losses and valuation
lead.summary: Outlets including Yahoo Finance, Memeburn and FourWeekMBA report on Anthropic's IPO filing. Yahoo Finance reports a $1.5 trillion valuation. Memeburn cites a $23 billion loss in the Q3 filing at 12x revenue, and FourWeekMBA says 91% of a $104 billion loss is fair-value remeasurement. Barchart reports the company is spending nearly $900 billion on AI. The headlines do not reconcile these loss figures.

main.headline: Anthropic releases open-source FlashProve to verify which model wrote an output
main.summary: Anthropic published research on FlashProve, a system that uses cryptographic proofs to confirm an output came from a specific AI model. Labs would publish a "fingerprint" of each model that does not reveal its weights. Anthropic says a single H100 GPU generates proofs at about 110 tokens per second for a 400-billion-parameter model, at roughly 70-95 times the GPU time of running the model. The code is under the Apache 2.0 license, and Anthropic says it has no plans to deploy the system.

main.headline: Google will disable AI tools in schools by default, cutting Search for opt-outs
main.summary: Google said Tuesday it will turn off AI tools for K-12 students next year unless administrators enable them, covering Gemini, NotebookLM, Gemini in Classroom and Search. Schools that restrict AI entirely will lose access to Google Search, because AI features are integrated into it. Google says the change follows consultations with schools and researchers. DuckDuckGo is pitching schools on switching their default search engine after the backlash.

main.headline: OpenAI agrees to acquire Pierre Computer to build out Codex
main.summary: OpenAI said it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, maker of Code Storage and the Trees and Diffs libraries already used in the Codex app. OpenAI says it wants to adapt Git workflows to coding agents. Pierre's open-source projects will stay open source, and Code Storage customers can keep using it after closing. The deal is subject to customary conditions, including regulatory approvals.
